snippet.title: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3849000/The_Lantern_of_the_Laughless_Saint/?curator_clanid=4777282

A solo or co-op RPG inspired by Morrowind. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.
